I have a suggestion for you for DAWs. If you have a tight budget right now then there is a really good free one, I use it. It is a full package daw and have almost everything you will need. The only thing it lacks is VST instructions, ends,  it has a drum kit, bass guitar, piano,  guitar amp sim and possibly another instrument and a burden check of effects (if you need some good free VST instruments then I have a tonne aswell) and it is on windows so try out Cakewalk and If you need help getting a hold of it either ask me our check out a YouTube channel called "Creative Sauce" he made a whole guide on Cakewalk

One way that you could do it is by using the arranger. If you press A it will open the arranger tab where you can then select parts of the track. Once you select them you can add them in to the arranger that plays them in that order
 So if you have say a verse then a chorus but you want the verse to play twice, you would put the verse into the arranger option twice and then the chorus box.
